original_provenance.author: qubodup
original_provenance.title: (defect) motor loop
original_provenance.processing: Mono 48 kHz PCM16 source edit; high/low-pass filtering; 120 ms seam crossfade; peak target -12 dBFS; then Ogg Vorbis quality 4.

files.processing: Original tyre/wind/engine pass-by synthesis with filtered CC0 motor texture; distant city sound design, not a field recording. Mono 24 kHz, bounded peak/RMS, faded edges, Vorbis quality 3.
files.integration_cue: 24 s exterior loop; ambience bus; gain .20 before category volume; strongest within 18 m of exit, very quiet deeper inside.
files.verification: Full decoded sample/level/loop-seam inspection. Listening and browser mix review remain required.

original_provenance.title: Dripping water loop
original_provenance.author: Independent.nu
original_provenance.processing: FFmpeg 7.1.5: downmixed source stereo FLAC to mono 44100Hz Vorbis quality 4 for positional ambience. Original duration retained.

files.processing: Original rain/drop synthesis mixed with CC0 flowing/dripping water using a source-loop seam crossfade. Mono 24 kHz, bounded peak/RMS, faded edges, Vorbis quality 3.
files.integration_cue: 18 s loop; fade to gain .35 near exit puddle; do not layer at full gain with lv113-exit-rain.
files.verification: Full decoded sample/level/loop-seam inspection. Listening and browser mix review remain required.

files.title: Distant Thunder
files.author: Last Vehicle original synthesis and edits; CC0 source recording authors recorded below
files.processing: Original low-frequency colored-noise weather rumble with soft attack and delayed rolling tail; no sampled thunder. Mono 24 kHz, bounded peak/RMS, faded edges, Vorbis quality 3.
files.integration_cue: 6 s occasional weather cue, gain .30; suppress during pursuit/attack/story impacts and allow >=45 s cooldown.
files.verification: Full decoded sample/level/loop-seam inspection. Listening and browser mix review remain required.

original_provenance.title: Mechanical Sounds
original_provenance.processing: Band limiting; short edge fades; peak target -7 dBFS; then Ogg Vorbis quality 4.

files.processing: CC0 metal clank onset trimmed, pitched 1.8x, with three diminishing bounces and original resonant metal partials. Mono 24 kHz, bounded peak/RMS, faded edges, Vorbis quality 3.
files.integration_cue: One .74 s cue at the projectile's first physical contact, positional gain .40; contains its own small bounce tail; do not retrigger every physics step.

files.name: lv114-player-breath
files.title: Player Breath
files.author: Last Vehicle original synthesis and edits; CC0 source recording authors recorded below
files.processing: Original unvoiced filtered-noise inhale/exhale synthesis, three soft breath pairs; no sampled voice, heartbeat or creature cue. Mono 24 kHz, bounded peak/RMS, faded edges, Vorbis quality 3.
files.integration_cue: 6 s centered SFX loop; fade with player sprint/stamina only, suggested gain .20-.45; mute on pause and never infer hidden enemy proximity.
files.verification: Full decoded sample/level/loop-seam inspection. Listening and browser mix review remain required.
